owner_request: 2026-10-13: owner's ETHUSDT.P 1H chart (OKX, Beijing) 2026-10-07 07:00-09:00 with the six SPIKE MAs (SMA/EMA 20/60/120, 双均线 V1.1): every line folds at the same bar, a corner not a smooth curve (锐角 or 钝角); 「我理解只需要检测3根k」; of the candidate extra features the owner picked only 「六条线从同一点散开」; then 「扫吧，多币种 1H 两年，钝角锐角分开」
question: On 1H, does a three-bar six-MA fold (lines converged near one point and all turning hard in the same direction at the same bar, then fanning out with EMA20 in front) pick entries in the fold direction that beat matched random entries with the same stop distance and 3R/5R targets after 0.2% cost, in both periods, separately for obtuse and acute folds?
prior_evidence: exp-ma6-knot-breakout-20261011-v1: tight knot + first close beyond all six MAs, 1H short 5R net +0.10 then -0.20R, no timeframe passed; exp-owner-squeeze-breakout-20261008-v1: 1H the only timeframe net positive in both periods, excess not significant. New here: the trigger is the simultaneous corner of all six lines (slope ratio per line) plus the fan-out, not a close beyond the rope, and folds are split by the shape before the vertex.

rule.bars: K1 = i-2, K2 = i-1 (vertex), K3 = i (decision bar); slope s_j(t) = MA_j(t) - MA_j(t-1) for the six MAs
rule.converge: six-MA width (max - min) at K2 / ATR14 at K2 <= 1.0 (example 0.64)
rule.turn: every MA slope at K3 has the fold sign and |s_j(K3)| >= 3 |s_j(K2)| (example: smallest ratio 5.4, SMA120)
rule.fan: six-MA width at K3 >= 1.3 x width at K2 (example 1.50) and EMA20 is the outermost MA on the fold side at K3 (example: EMA20 lowest)
rule.side: fold down -> short, fold up -> long
rule.angle: obtuse when >= 4 of the six K2 slopes point in the fold direction (acceleration), acute when >= 4 point against it (reversal), mixed otherwise (reported, no claim)
rule.threshold_source: single owner example, OKX ETH-USDT-SWAP 1H 2026-10-07 09:00 Beijing (K3); round numbers at or beyond its values; the scanned data ends 2026-09-23, before it

variant_notes: primary = converge + turn + fan; turn_2 / turn_1_5 lower the per-line turn ratio to 2 / 1.5; no_fan drops the fan condition; converge_2 widens converge to 2.0 ATR. Every variant is reported per angle group and for all angles together. The turn variants were added before any return was computed: on six majors (2024-10..2026-09, 104k 1H bars) converge + all six same sign + ratio >= 3 occurred 4 times (ratio 2: 48, 1.5: 139), too rare for primary alone to be judged
stop: long: min(six MAs at K3) - 0.2 ATR14; short: max(six MAs at K3) + 0.2 ATR14; skip when the entry is not beyond the stop
exit_path: as exp-owner-squeeze-breakout-20261008-v1: bar high/low from the entry bar, gaps fill at the open, stop first when both print in one bar, exit at the close after max_hold_bars, a missing bar before the exit drops the trade

controls.pool: same symbol and calendar month, ready bars, not the event bar, ATR/price within 0.5-2x the event's
controls.stop: same stop distance in ATR units as the event, same side

data.source: frozen Binance USD-M 5m series data/research/spike_v128_entry_clock_long_20260923/series, complete-bucket 1H resampling; per month the top 100 alts by previous-month median daily quote volume (stables excluded) plus BTC/ETH
data.example_check: OKX ETH-USDT-SWAP 1H data/research/ma6_fold_fan_1h_20261013 (2026-07-21 to 2026-10-13): does primary fire at 2026-10-07 09:00 Beijing, and with which angle

primary: per angle group (obtuse, acute), side and target, variant primary: mean net R and excess over matched controls in each period; a group qualifies only if both periods are net positive after cost and excess is positive with month-block sign-flip p < 0.05 in at least one. The all-angle rows, mixed angle and the other variants are read against primary only
